decisions.reason: The IMU module remains a low-cost, core building block that fits the modular system, and the growing firm has enough slack to carry it, although the move to newer connectors may eventually require a successor version.
The industrial AC voltage input module is prominently presented and serves the industrial users the firm targets, so there is no shortfall against aspiration that would prompt search for other uses.
The newly launched RGB LED module needs time to show results, and with slack from growth management will carry it rather than judge it prematurely.
Remote access for wallboxes supports the strategic expansion of charging and energy management, so its value lies in the direction the firm is heading and it is unlikely to be dropped.
